author: Rigsters on Sketchfab
note: Photogrammetry scan by Rigsters of a Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton replica displayed at Knuthenborg Safaripark, Denmark. This is a different replica, not SUE or a scan of SUE’s fossils; it is uniformly scaled to the catalog’s approximate 12.3 m length using the skull-to-tail longitudinal extent. The replica’s pose and proportions are retained. A rapid single-loop capture leaves holes and incomplete surfaces, especially visible from the reverse side; these have not been filled with invented bones or surfaces.
basis_label: SUE size context; displayed replica differs

operations: Pack the downloadable glTF as self-contained GLB; resize original textures to at most 1024 pixels
Static scene deduplication, flatten, join, weld; decimate existing surfaces
Prune unused resources; quantize positions to 16 bits, normals to 12 bits, UVs to 14 bits; no decoder compression
Preserve source materials, geometry proportions and pose; no added geometry or labels
